exclusion_description: Retain 10% of fast successful public listing access logs; retain all other records.
exclusion_filter:
resource.type="k8s_container"
resource.labels.namespace_name="ingress-nginx"
resource.labels.container_name="controller"
log_id("stdout")
severity < WARNING
insertId:*
textPayload =~ "^\S+ - \S+ \[[^\]]+\] \"(?:GET|HEAD) /v0(?:\.1)?/servers(?:\?[^ \"\\]*)? HTTP/[0-9.]+\" (?:200|304) [0-9]+ \"[^\"\\]*\" \"[^\"\\]*\" [0-9]+ 0\.[0-9]+ \[[^\]]*\] \[[^\]]*\] \S+ (?:-|[0-9]+) (?:-|[0-9.]+) (?:-|200|304) \S+ cache_status=\"(?:HIT|MISS|STALE|UPDATING|EXPIRED|BYPASS|REVALIDATED|-)\" "
sample(insertId, 0.9)
